source.source_text: Purpose: cancel only a Broker-owned cancellable job; cannot signal arbitrary host PID. Input: job_id:string, reason?:string<=200. Output: prior/new state and cancellation verification. Contract: L2 writes_local; scope mac.job.cancel; target job_id; timeout 10000ms; cap 128KiB; network none; filesystem broker_job_artifacts; secrets redacted; approval trusted_write; repeated cancel is safe/idempotent by job state. Phase 3 planned.
